records.key: Image quality: the longest edge the plate, well and image views load, from 128 pixels up to Original, the full resolution, at the top
records.source: Image quality: the longest edge the plate, well and image views load, from 128 pixels up to Original, the full resolution, at the top
records.translation: 图像质量：板视图、孔视图和图像视图加载的最长边，从 128 像素到最高位置的“原始分辨率”（完整分辨率）

records.key: Zoom and pan every open image together. Off, only the image under the pointer zooms.
records.source: Zoom and pan every open image together. Off, only the image under the pointer zooms.
records.translation: 所有打开的图像一起缩放和平移。关闭时，只缩放指针下方的图像。

records.source: Longest edge, in pixels, of the images the plate, well and image views load: 128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048 or 4096, or 0 for Original, the full source resolution. Lower values load faster and use less memory; zooming in still reads original pixels. The image-quality slider sets it, and its top position is Original. Default 1024.
records.translation: 板视图、孔视图和图像视图加载的图像的最长边像素数：128、256、512、1024、2048 或 4096，或 0 表示“原始分辨率”，即源图像的完整分辨率。较小的值加载更快、占用内存更少；放大时仍读取原始像素。由图像质量滑块设置，滑块的最高位置即“原始分辨率”。默认值 1024。
